title: "Industry"
as_of: "2026-10-07"

Business and industry items on low-altitude economy use and development: delivery routes, eVTOL orders and test flights, funding, partnerships and launches, in Hong Kong, the Greater Bay Area and among key global players. Government and regulatory items stay on News; official status stays on Tracker.

## How to read the tags

Each item carries one source-type tag:

- **Company-announced:** the claim comes from the company itself (press release, launch event, social post). It is the company's claim, not an established fact.
- **Independently reported:** a news outlet reported it from its own sources or checks, beyond the company's statement.
- **Officially confirmed:** a government body or regulator has confirmed it in an official release or document, which is linked.

Company claims are not treated as fact on this site. Order values, fleet sizes, delivery counts and launch dates are shown as claimed, with who claimed them. Do not cite this page for official figures; use Tracker.

## Update schedule

Updates run on Tuesday, Thursday and Sunday. Evidence is collected at 5:52 PM Hong Kong time, the site draft is prepared at 7:07 PM Hong Kong time, and changes are published only after instructor approval.

Items that lack a date, an outlet or a source-type tag are dropped.

## How items appear

Each item: date · outlet, a one-line headline, then Tag / What's new / Status / Read instead, with the quoted source text in a collapsed box where the source is in Chinese or has official English and Chinese versions.

## Items

The first items will appear with the next scheduled update.
